list.name: Changes
list.comment: - Add interactive loan calculator and 3D feature cards - Implement application form modal with INN input - Integrate fetch API to send POST requests to /api/client/applications - Add dynamic status rendering (Approved/Rejected) based on orchestrator response - Apply Alfa-Bank corporate branding styles (fonts, colors, layout)

MESSAGE.value: update pipeline with BA scoring logic and fix mocks by analise of business-analitic

-Add INN checksum validation using FNS algorithm -Implement strict Enum for loan purposes to prevent parsing errors -Add data enrichment logic to update Company profile from EGRUL mock -Improve error handling: fallback to MANUAL_REVIEW on mock failures/timeouts -Add human-readable error messages to check_results table -Update DB schema: add cascades, indexes, reason_code for decisions -Fix decision logic: prevent approved_amount generation for REJECTED statuses -Add CORS middleware for frontend integration -Update mock data with 5 valid INN scenarios (approved, counter-offer, rejected, etc.)"
